name: apply_condition
description: Applies a condition to a character or NPC. Standard D&D 2024 conditions: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Grappled, Incapacitated, Invisible, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Unconscious. Exhaustion is tracked with its level (e.g. 'Exhaustion 1', 'Exhaustion 2'). Returns an error if the condition is already active.

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a player character or an NPC.

entity.description: The slug or name of the target character or NPC.
